descriptionByLocale.de:
J e t z t b e w e r b e n
Jede grosse Reise beginnt mit einem kleinen Schritt.
Planst du einen neuen beruflichen Weg einzuschlagen?
Very personal: Asanti ist ein spezialisierter Personaldienstleister aus Dietikon. Wir unterstützen Stellensuchende und Unternehmen in kaufmännischen, technischen und industriellen Berufen – persönlich, ehrlich und auf Augenhöhe.
Bist du bereit, dich auf eine Berufsreise mit mir zu begeben?
Technisch versierte:r Kaufm. Mitarbeiter:in 80–100% (alle)
Du überzeugst, wenn du mehr bist als nur Zahlen und Fakten – nämlich eine Persönlichkeit mit Leidenschaft für das Kaufmännische und einem Flair für Technik. Idealerweise hast du deine KV-Ausbildung abgeschlossen und bereits mit ersten Weiterbildungen ergänzt.
Für unsere Kunden im Raum Zürich und Limmattal suchen wir jemanden mit:
- kaufmännischer Grundbildung und bestenfalls Berufserfahrung in einem technischen Umfeld oder Handelsunternehmen
- vertraut mit den kaufm. Prozessen im Bereich Einkauf, Innendienst und/oder Marketing
- sichere Fremdsprachenkenntnissen in Französisch, Englisch oder Italienisch – ein absolutes Plus!
- einer empathischen, selbstständigen und verantwortungsbewussten Art mit gesundem Durchsetzungsvermögen
Auch für weitere Kunden im Raum Zürich und Aargau, könntest genau DU als perfekter Match sein.Deine Aufgaben sind so vielfältig wie du selbst – bei uns darfst du sein, wie du bist. Wir suchen Teamplayer mit Engagement, Charme und positiver Energie, die die Arbeitswelt bereichern wollen.
Was mir wichtig ist? Deine Persönlichkeit.
Sei authentisch, zeig mir, was dich ausmacht – und heb dich von der Masse ab.
→ Bewirb dich und nenne mir 3 Gründe, warum genau du ein Gewinn für ein Team bist.
Nicht jede Bewerbung führt direkt zum perfekten Match – und wir können nicht alle Kandidat:innen gleich intensiv begleiten oder einladen.
Aber wenn es passt, setzen wir alles daran, gemeinsam deinen nächsten Schritt möglich zu machen.
Vielleicht lernen wir uns schon bald kennen und finden deinen nächsten Karriereschritt. Ich freue mich auf dich!
Hinweis: Aktuell können wir nur Bewerbungen von Kandidat:innen mit Wohnsitz und relevanter Berufserfahrung in der Schweiz berücksichtigen.
Bereit mit mir die neue berufliche Reise anzusteuern?
Ich freue mich auf die vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.
Carmen Kistler
Senior Personalberaterin
Kaufmännische Berufe

J e t z t b e r b
Ogni grande viaggio inizia con un piccolo passo.
Stai pianificando un nuovo percorso di carriera?
Personale molto: Asanti è un fornitore specializzato di servizi del personale di Dietikon. Sosteniamo i cercatori di lavoro e le aziende in professioni commerciali, tecniche e industriali – personalmente, onestamente e su un piano di parità.
Sei pronto a fare un viaggio professionale con me?
Tecnicamente esperto:r Kaufm. Dipendenti: in 80-100% (tutti)
Convinci quando sei più che solo figure e fatti – ovvero una personalità con una passione per il commercio e un tocco di tecnologia. Idealmente, hai completato la tua formazione CV e già completato con la formazione iniziale ulteriore.
Per i nostri clienti nella zona di Zurigo e Limmattal, stiamo cercando qualcuno con:
- istruzione commerciale di base e, al meglio, esperienza professionale in un ambiente tecnico o impresa commerciale
- familiarità con l'acquisto. Processi nel campo dell'acquisto, del servizio interno e/o del marketing
- competenze di lingua straniera sicuro in francese, inglese o italiano – un plus assoluto!
- una specie empatetica, autosufficiente e responsabile con sana assertività
Anche per altri clienti nella zona di Zurigo e Aargau, si potrebbe essere esattamente come una partita perfetta. I vostri compiti sono diversi come voi stessi – con noi potete essere come siete. Siamo alla ricerca di giocatori di squadra con impegno, fascino e energia positiva che vogliono arricchire il mondo del lavoro.
Cosa c'è di importante per me? La tua personalità.
Sii autentico, mostrami cosa ti fa – e distinguerti dalla folla.
→ Applicare e darmi 3 motivi per cui esattamente sei una vittoria per una squadra.
Non ogni applicazione porta direttamente alla partita perfetta – e non possiamo accompagnare o invitare tutti i candidati in modo altrettanto intensivo.
Ma se si adatta, facciamo tutto il possibile per rendere il vostro prossimo passo possibile insieme.
Forse ci conosceremo presto e troveremo il tuo prossimo passo di carriera. Non vedo l'ora di vederti!
Nota: Attualmente possiamo considerare le domande dei candidati con residenza ed esperienza professionale rilevante in Svizzera.
Pronta per il nuovo viaggio professionale con me?
Attendo con ansia i documenti di applicazione completi.
Carmen Kistler
Consulente di reclutamento senior
Professioni commerciali
Tel. 043 355 22 88

Every great journey begins with a small step.
Are you planning a new career path?
Very personnel: Asanti is a specialized personnel service provider from Dietikon. We support job seekers and companies in commercial, technical and industrial professions – personally, honestly and on an equal footing.
Are you ready to go on a professional trip with me?
Technically savvy:r Kaufm. Employees: in 80-100% (all)
You convince when you are more than just figures and facts – namely a personality with a passion for the commercial and a flair for technology. Ideally, you have completed your CV training and already supplemented with initial further training.
For our customers in the Zurich and Limmattal area, we are looking for someone with:
- basic commercial education and, at best, professional experience in a technical environment or commercial enterprise
- familiar with the Purchase. Processes in the field of purchasing, in-house service and/or marketing
- safe foreign language skills in French, English or Italian – an absolute plus!
- an empathetic, self-reliant and responsible species with healthy assertiveness
Also for other customers in the area of Zurich and Aargau, you could be exactly as a perfect match.Your tasks are as diverse as yourself – with us you can be as you are. We are looking for team players with commitment, charm and positive energy who want to enrich the working world.
What is important to me? Your personality.
Be authentic, show me what makes you – and stand out from the crowd.
→ Apply and give me 3 reasons why exactly you are a win for a team.
Not every application leads directly to the perfect match – and we cannot accompany or invite all candidates equally intensively.
But if it fits, we do everything we can to make your next step possible together.
Maybe we will get to know each other soon and find your next career step. I look forward to seeing you!
Note: Currently we can only consider applications from candidates with residence and relevant professional experience in Switzerland.
Ready to head for the new professional journey with me?
I look forward to the full application documents.

For our customer in the district of Baden, we are looking for a committed and reliable personality as
Accounts Receivable & Quotation Clerk (40-60%) / try&hire
Responsibilities:
Accounts Receivable & Administration
- Recording, checking and posting invoices
- Preparation of final invoices including enclosures, warranty certificates and service contracts
- Opening and adapting projects and construction contracts in the ERP system
- Monitoring incoming payments and supporting the dunning process
- Creation of construction guarantees
- Maintaining the address master data in ABACUS
- Responsible for archiving and filing
Quotation & order processing
- Supporting the calculator in the preparation of quotations
- Editing tender and acquisition platforms such as Olmero and SiMap
- Entering, opening and sending offers
- Processing quotes, foreign exchange and orders
- Preparing work contracts and creating order confirmations
- Obtaining material prices and creating price requests
- Processing cancellations and active follow-up for open offers
- Maintaining incoming orders and the order book
- Maintaining the reference list
- Obtaining credit reports and checking customer terms and conditions
Administration and reception
- Supervising the telephone exchange and first point of contact for internal and external contacts
- Administrative and organisational tasks
Your Insight:
- Commercial training or a comparable qualification
- Ideally, experience in the construction industry, main construction or ancillary construction industry or in a construction-related company
- Practical experience in quotation, order processing and/or accounts receivable
- Understanding of commercial processes relating to construction projects, work contracts and invoicing
- Safe use of MS Office; knowledge of ABACUS and ERP systems is a plus
- Independent, structured and precise working methods
- Organisational talent with a pronounced flair for numbers
- Communication skills, teamwork skills and a friendly demeanour
- Pleasure in taking responsibility and coordinating different areas of responsibility
What to expect:
- A varied and responsible position with a wide range of commercial tasks
- A collegial, well-positioned team in a down-to-earth construction company
- Versatile interfaces and a lively working day
- Infrastructure
- Attractive employment conditions and good social benefits
- Entry into the Try & Hire model with the possibility of a subsequent permanent position with mutual fit
